strain: To understand how Glc7 is recruited to chromatin to dephosphorylate H3T11, we immunoprecipitated the endogenous FLAG-tagged Glc7 (Glc7-FLAG) from yeast cells, and mass spectrometry (IP-MS) analysis detected the presence of chromatin-associated protein, Sen1 (Fig. 3a).
